lion.name: Lion
lion.description: The lion is a large cat of the genus Panthera native to Africa and India. It has a muscular, broad-chested body, short rounded head, round ears, and a hairy tuft at the end of its tail.
lion.diet: Carnivorous - primarily large mammals like zebras, wildebeests, and buffaloes
lion.lifespan: 10-14 years in the wild, up to 20 years in captivity

elephant.name: Elephant
elephant.description: Elephants are the largest existing land animals, characterized by their long proboscis (trunk), columnar legs, and huge heads with temporal glands and wide, flat ears.
elephant.diet: Herbivorous - grasses, leaves, bark, fruit, and soil

panda.name: Giant Panda
panda.description: The giant panda is a bear native to South Central China. It is characterized by its bold black-and-white coat and rotund body.
panda.habitat: Mountain ranges in central China with dense bamboo forests
panda.diet: Primarily bamboo (99% of diet), occasionally small animals
panda.lifespan: 20 years in the wild, up to 30 years in captivity

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.subtitle: How we use cookies to enhance your experience
cookies.intro: This Cookies Policy explains how we use cookies to enhance your experience when you visit our app and use its features. By using this app, you consent to the use of cookies as described in this policy.

sections.title: What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit websites or use apps. They help us understand how you interact with our service and allow us to provide you with a better, more personalized experience.

sections.title: How We Use Cookies
sections.content: We use cookies for several essential purposes:
list: To analyze traffic patterns and improve user experience
To enable certain features and functionality of our app
To remember your preferences and settings
To provide secure access to your account

sections.title: Types of Cookies We Use
sections.content: We use different types of cookies to enhance your experience:
list: Essential Cookies: Required for basic app functionality
Performance Cookies: Help us understand how you use the app
Functional Cookies: Remember your preferences and choices
Analytics Cookies: Provide insights into app usage patterns

sections.title: Managing Cookies
sections.content: You can control and manage cookies through your device settings. However, please note that disabling certain cookies may affect your experience and limit the functionality of the app.

sections.title: Cookie Duration
sections.content: Some cookies are temporary (session cookies) and are deleted when you close the app. Others remain on your device for a set period to remember your preferences across sessions.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Cookies Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology or legal requirements. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions, concerns, or feedback regarding this Cookies Policy, please contact us at leafnest.capstone@gmail.com.

cookies.footerText: We are committed to transparency about how we use cookies. Your continued use of our app indicates your acceptance of this policy.

items.question: What is LeafNest?
items.answer: LeafNest is a plant identification and information app that uses AI technology to help you identify plants and animals to provide knowledge about nature.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Open the app, tap the scan icon, and point it at any plant or animal. The AI will identify it and provide detailed information about that species.

items.question: How do I scan a species?
items.answer: Tap the scan icon on the home screen, point your camera at the species, and capture a clear photo. The app will automatically identify it.

items.question: What makes a good scan?
items.answer: Ensure good lighting, focus on distinctive features, and keep the camera steady for the best results.

items.question: Can I scan from my photo gallery?
items.answer: Yes. You can upload existing photos from your gallery by selecting the gallery option in the scanner screen.

items.question: How accurate is the identification?
items.answer: LeafNest uses advanced machine learning models. Accuracy varies by lighting and image quality, but typically exceeds 90%.

items.question: Can I save my favorite plants?
items.answer: Yes. Tap the heart icon on any identified species to add it to your favorites for quick access later.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: Open the Settings menu and select Help & Support, or email us at leafnest.capstone@gmail.com.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Tips for scanning plants & animals with AI — and where to get more help.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
bullets: Tap the Scan button from the home screen.
Center the plant or animal in the frame.
Hold steady, then capture a clear photo.

bestResults.title: How to get better results
bullets: Use good lighting and avoid harsh backlight.
Fill the frame with the subject, focusing on distinctive details.
Try multiple angles such as leaves, flowers, bark, or profile shots.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
bullets: Daily highlights look the same? Pull to refresh or reopen the app after midnight (Philippine time).
No internet? Check your connection because image recognition needs a network connection.
Low accuracy? Take a clearer, closer photo with better lighting.
